annotations.text:
THE FLOW, PHONE FIRST — the manager doing this is standing at the console, not at a desk.

Landing → photograph the console → wait → check what was read → nozzle slips → variance → confirm.

Two rules run through every screen. (1) TYPING IS NOT A FALLBACK. Camera and keyboard are the same size, the same border, the same height, side by side — and each figure carries a badge saying which one produced it. (2) NOTHING DEAD-ENDS. Every screen has a way forward, including the ones where the camera failed.

SKIP lands straight on the editable readings — it does not pass through the progress bar. A man who has decided to type should not be made to watch a spinner first.

EXIF ORIENTATION: the landscape prompt is worth nothing if the upload arrives rotated. Honour the EXIF tag before the image reaches OCR.

THE BAR FILLS TO 90% AND HOLDS. It never animates to 100 before the answer is back, and the labels are three real stages, not decoration. A bar that claims to be finished and then sits there is exactly how a manager learns not to trust the camera.

SCREENS 4 AND 4a ARE ONE SCREEN (owner, 27-Aug). Partial is the normal state, not an error screen — the nine that read sit beside the three that didn't, and each unread one offers camera and keyboard together.

MATT SHEET, IN SHADE — not a transparent folder. Plastic throws glare, and glare is what killed the 25-Aug console shot.

SAVED BEFORE HE DECIDES — as a DRAFT. His to resume, but not in the ledger and not on the owner's dashboard until he presses Confirm.

Start again does NOT delete it: the draft is marked abandoned and kept. A recon that vanishes when a man changes his mind is a recon he will not start twice.

TESTING GETS ITS OWN LINE. Folded into sales it becomes an unexplained variance every single day.

THE SWITCH IS A MIGRATION FLAG, NOT A FEATURE (owner, 27-Aug: "do not forget. we have to have the switch in the settings").

It joins the four that already live on station_settings — products_enabled, self_settlement_enabled, accounts_enabled, attendant_led_autoclose — and it is OFF by default and stays off. Kamala, Adhoc and Highway are working; nothing about this reaches them.

IT REFUSES TO FLIP WITH A SHIFT OPEN. Half a shift under one model and half under another leaves an opening reading nobody can defend.

ROLLBACK IS THE SWITCH ITSELF. Off restores the old sidebar and the old flow; the recons taken meanwhile stay on file as recons.
TOP STEPPER CHOSEN (owner, 27-Aug) — the right-hand rail is gone. It broke on a phone, and the phone is where this work actually happens.

STEP 2 EXISTED IN THE STEPPER BUT HAD NO SCREEN — the manager arrived at Nozzles with a tick he never earned. Spoke 1 is THREE inputs (ATG, deliveries, slips); this screen is the second. NOTHING IS ENTERED HERE: decants were captured when the tanker landed. One question — is the window complete? ‘Add’ opens the everyday Deliveries form (cardinal rule: reuse).

RULE 3 — THE CTA IS EARNED, NOT OFFERED (owner, 27-Aug). A step’s button sits grey and unlit until this screen’s job is fully captured, and while grey it SAYS what is missing (‘Waiting on 1 nozzle — 15BC1412V.2’). It lights orange the moment the job is done. Escape hatches (skip, provisional, add-later) live as quiet secondary buttons — available, never clamouring. The three spokes gate separately: no spoke ever waits on another’s inputs.
